title: Ramesh Nath Pandey v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed for want of prosecution; Code not construed.
headnote: Writ-C No. 43073 of 2019, earlier listed so that the petitioner could annex the Executive Engineer's order under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, was dismissed for want of prosecution when none appeared even in the revised call. The Court did not construe Clause 6.5 or decide the underlying billing dispute.
facts: Ramesh Nath Pandey filed Writ-C No. 43073 of 2019 against the State of U.P. and another. On 2 January 2020 the Court listed the matter so the petitioner could file a supplementary affidavit annexing the Executive Engineer's order under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 12 February 2020 respondent no. 2 was given three weeks to counter. On 16 May 2023 none appeared for the petitioner even on the revised call.

holding_units.holding: Where none appeared for the petitioner even in the revised call, the Division Bench dismissed the writ for want of prosecution without construing Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 or deciding the billing dispute.

principle_tags.application: The writ was listed for a supplementary affidavit of the Executive Engineer's Clause 6.5 order and later for a counter, then dismissed for want of prosecution; no portable construction of Clause 6.5 was laid down.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's challenge and any Executive Engineer order under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The writ was dismissed for want of prosecution without examining the bill or the Clause 6.5 record.
